WL Construction — Brand Identity

A complete brand system for a Cebu construction firm, from the logo and guidelines to the company profile, social media and a marketing plan. Presented June 2026.

ClientWL Construction, Cebu
ScopeBrand identity & marketing
CreativesErika Niña Cotiangco
3Logo versions
4Brand colours
30+Social & print designs
117Pages in the brand proposal

From the brand book

The brief

WL Construction is a Cebu-based firm building residential, commercial and institutional projects across Cebu and the Visayas. Its work was solid, but its look was not consistent. The firm needed an identity that matched its engineering standards and a kit it could use everywhere: signage, uniforms, tarpaulins, proposals and social media.

The idea behind the mark

The logo is modern and minimalist, and every line has a job:

  • The W and L initials form the base of the mark.
  • Structural columns and support beams stand for stability and strength in execution.
  • A rising roofline signals progress and the firm's aim to lead in Philippine construction.
  • A small window at the centre is a reminder that every build is a space where people live, work and grow.

Colour & type

Navy#25264CMain logo colour: professionalism, engineering
Gold#F0B819Accent: premium feel, highlights
Off-white#F5F5F5Backgrounds, clean layouts
Charcoal#4B4B4BText, secondary elements

Inter is the single typeface across the whole system, from business cards to social posts.

What we delivered

Brand guidelines

  • Primary, secondary and icon logos
  • Logo variations on navy, gold and white
  • Usage rules, plus do's and don'ts

Visual system

  • Custom icon set
  • Logo-based patterns
  • Imagery direction and colour treatment

Company profile

  • About, mission, vision and core values
  • Services and completed projects
  • Professional team and consultants

Social media & print

  • Service spotlight and project showcase posts
  • Hiring, trivia and testimonial templates
  • Business cards

Marketing strategy

  • Campaign goals and objectives
  • Channels, schedule and target audience
  • KPIs and a rollout roadmap
